name: list_task_templates
description: Public, local and read-only. Inspect small task recipes and requirements before quoting. Does not call an API, rent a GPU, install dependencies or reserve capacity.

name: prepare_task_template
description: Local preparation only. Returns a command and optional Workspace/output fields; never submits or spends money. Quote, explicit GPU/budget/time approval and existing storage consent are still required by run_job. No guaranteed application compatibility or automatic retry.

name: compare_compute_costs
description: Read-only live quote comparison for up to eight explicit compatible GPU candidates. Accounts for minimum one-hour versus per-minute billing. No capacity reservation, GPU creation, benchmark, automatic selection or approval. Run estimate_cost for the selected rental afterward.

name: prepare_task_pipeline
description: Local read-only preparation of 1–8 reviewed commands for one bounded Job or an approved existing rental. Reuses GPU and disk across steps; stops on the first error. Does not create, retry, install dependencies, approve spending or change an instance lifecycle. Summary persistence is optional and never implies paid-storage consent.

name: get_job_batch_receipt
description: Read only saved accepted Job IDs and uncertain submission intents for the original batch key, API key and endpoint. No API request or GPU creation. Local state is historical, not live release evidence; a missing entry does not prove non-creation. Commands, tokens and signed URLs are never stored.

name: prepare_job_batch
description: Local, read-only preparation for up to eight Jobs with fresh per-Job quotes and one aggregate cap. No API requests, reservations, installations or automatic execution retries. Retain the immutable plan hash and batch key.

name: get_job_batch
description: Read-only status and cost summary for explicit Job IDs. Does not retry, cancel, create or claim independent supplier release verification.

name: run_job_batch
description: Paid: submit an explicitly approved immutable manifest using existing durable Jobs, each with a quote, budget and deadline. Aggregate worst-case budget is capped. Partial success is possible. On lost responses replay the IDENTICAL manifest/key; never create replacement GPUs or retry failed execution automatically. Persist the returned receipt. No transaction rollback or independent batch scheduler.

name: get_storage
description: Storage availability, used bytes, reserved uploads and account quota. No money is spent.

name: list_files
description: Persistent artifacts, model/data files and Workspace files. Availability depends on storage being enabled.

name: list_workspaces
description: Saved project Workspaces; versions are immutable file manifests.

name: list_workspace_versions
description: List saved immutable versions of an owned Workspace.

name: get_workspace_version
description: Read the path-to-file manifest for an owned version.

name: list_workspace_instances
description: Lists your running GPUs that this key may access. Budgeted Agent keys only see instances created by the same key.

name: get_workspace_application
description: Check file restoration on an existing GPU. This does not create, stop or restart a GPU. An uncertain result must be checked, never automatically resubmitted.

name: apply_workspace
description: Restore project files to a new private directory on your existing running GPU. Does not install dependencies, execute code, overwrite existing files, rent, restart or stop a GPU. GPU rental billing continues; transfer consumes its network and disk. Ask the user before applying. Repeat requests for the same version and instance return the existing result; failures require inspection, not automatic retries.

name: delete_workspace_version
description: Deletes a saved version, releasing its file references. Refuses versions pinned by active Jobs. Ask the user first.

name: upload_artifact
description: Uploads a local regular file in resumable-sized parts. Consumes storage quota; retention and pricing depend on the account policy. Credential files are refused.

arguments.name: accept_storage_charges
arguments.desc: Read get_storage pricing first. Set true only after the user agrees to paid storage above the included allowance.

name: download_artifact
description: Streams a persistent file to this computer. Never overwrites an existing local file.

name: save_workspace
description: Saves 1–100 regular project files as an immutable version. Refuses secrets and symlinks; skips .git, node_modules, __pycache__ and .venv. Save dependency manifests, not the operating system. Pass the returned workspace_version_id to run_job.

arguments.name: accept_storage_charges
arguments.desc: Read get_storage pricing and obtain user agreement before enabling paid storage.

name: delete_file
description: Permanently deletes a persistent file or cancels an unfinished upload. Files pinned by a Workspace version cannot be deleted.

name: diagnose_job
description: Read-only Job diagnosis and observed platform instance state. Never creates, stops or retries a GPU. Does not claim supplier release verification or classify every command failure as user error.

name: save_job_output
description: With approval, persist the ended Job log tail as a small Artifact using existing storage quota and retention. This is not the full log or binary output collection. Refuses recognizable credentials, quoted/aliased fields and bounded escaped representations or queried URLs. This is not a guarantee that arbitrary logs contain no secrets; save only logs you know are sanitized. Never touches GPU resources. Reuses a matching verified snapshot when found; cross-client concurrent calls may create duplicates.

name: get_compute_catalog
description: GPU catalog, templates and billing without an API key. Does not rent anything.

name: quote_compute
description: Five-minute server quote: separates estimated task cost from required starting balance and marks supports_jobs. No GPU is started. Pass its quote_id to run_job.

name: get_account
description: Balance in USD, how many instances this account may run at once, and how many are running now.

name: list_gpus
description: GPU models you can rent now, with VRAM, live price per GPU-hour in USD and availability (ok / low / none). Prices are live; never assume them.

arguments.name: min_vram_gb
arguments.desc: Only GPUs with at least this much VRAM per card

arguments.name: gpu_model
arguments.desc: Filter by name, e.g. 4090, A100, H20

name: list_templates
description: Ready-made instance images (e.g. JupyterLab, Ollama, ComfyUI, LLaMA-Factory) with the GPU each recommends. Templates with has_api_endpoint get a public HTTPS api_url.

name: estimate_cost
description: Live price and estimated cost for a GPU, plus your balance after it. Returns a quote_id that create_instance needs. Show the quote to the user and get an explicit yes before renting.

arguments.name: gpu_model
arguments.desc: GPU model exactly as list_gpus returns it

arguments.name: template
arguments.desc: Template id from list_templates; omit for a plain GPU with Python and CUDA

name: list_models
description: Models on CloudGPU's OpenAI-compatible API (same key, same balance). Use them from code with base_url https://cloudgpu.app/v1 instead of renting a GPU when you only need inference.

name: connect_account
description: Use when there is no API key. Starts an approval request and returns a link. The user opens it, signs in to cloudgpu.app and approves this assistant with a spending limit and a maximum number of GPUs at once; CloudGPU's servers enforce both. Then call finish_connect. No money is spent.

arguments.name: agent_name
arguments.desc: How the user will recognise this assistant, e.g. 'my coding agent on my laptop'

arguments.name: spend_limit_usd
arguments.desc: Total this key may ever spend, in USD; ask the user

arguments.name: max_concurrent
arguments.desc: GPUs or jobs this key may run at once

name: finish_connect
description: After the user approved the link from connect_account: waits up to about a minute for the approval, then stores the new key on this computer (~/.config/cloudgpu/credentials.json, readable only by the user) and uses it from now on. The key itself is never shown.

name: get_job
description: Status of a job (queued / provisioning / running / stopping / succeeded / failed / cancelled / needs_attention), exit code, cost so far, the last ~4 KB of the command's output and the job's event history.

name: list_jobs
description: Recent jobs on this account with status and cost.

name: get_status
description: Status (creating / running / stopped / failed), minutes run, cost so far, whether SSH is ready, the public api_url if the template has one, and the auto-shutdown limits.

name: list_instances
description: Instances on this account: running, starting, and those stopped in the last 7 days, with cost.

name: create_instance
description: Rents the GPU from a quote. Costs money. Requires a quote_id from estimate_cost that the user has approved. max_spend_usd and max_hours are enforced by CloudGPU's servers: the instance is destroyed when either is reached, even if this assistant has disconnected. idle_minutes destroys it after the GPU sits idle that long (installing packages and downloading data count as idle, so allow for setup). setup_script (optional bash) runs once as root after the instance is handed over; its output is in /root/cloudgpu-setup.log.

arguments.name: user_confirmed
arguments.desc: true only if the user explicitly approved this quote in the conversation

arguments.name: max_spend_usd
arguments.desc: Budget for this instance in USD (at most 50)

arguments.name: max_hours
arguments.desc: Hard time limit in hours (at most 24)

arguments.name: idle_minutes
arguments.desc: Destroy after the GPU has been idle this long; 0 turns it off; otherwise at least 10

arguments.name: setup_script
arguments.desc: Optional bash script run once as root in the background after the instance is handed over; output in /root/cloudgpu-setup.log

name: resolve_model_reference
description: Read-only. Resolve a public Hugging Face model revision and explicit file list to immutable commit, sizes and available LFS SHA-256 checksums. Does not download weights, rent a GPU or authenticate to Hugging Face. Review model license and application compatibility separately.

name: prepare_model_deployment
description: Preparation only; no GPU is started. Create a reviewed setup script for the existing ComfyUI template. Downloads go from the public model host directly to the rented GPU, never through CloudGPU storage. Use model names as categories (checkpoints, loras, vae, diffusion_models, text_encoders, clip, controlnet, upscale_models). Does not install custom nodes, execute workflows, accept licenses for the user, or promise compatibility. Pass the setup_script only after explicit approval to the existing deployment flow.

name: prepare_job_rerun
description: Read-only. Retrieve the original command, pinned model references and Workspace without starting anything. Request a fresh quote, check Workspace expiry and obtain explicit budget approval before calling run_job with a NEW idempotency key. Never reuse the old quote or key.

name: run_job
description: Costs money. CloudGPU starts a GPU, runs one bash command on it, then destroys the GPU, all on its servers, so it finishes even if this assistant disconnects. max_spend_usd and max_hours are enforced by the servers. Retrying with the same idempotency_key never starts a second GPU; this tool generates one if you leave it out and returns it. The disk is erased when the job ends. When automatic_output_collection is available, declare outputs and write only those files under $CLOUDGPU_OUTPUT_DIR for persistent storage before release. Otherwise upload results yourself or print them. Storage retention and fees follow the account policy; collection consumes the same GPU budget and may fail. Requires the user's explicit yes on the GPU, budget and time limit.

arguments.name: command
arguments.desc: bash command or script to run on the GPU

arguments.name: gpu_model
arguments.desc: GPU model exactly as list_gpus returns it

arguments.name: disk_gb
arguments.desc: Larger system disk: 100, 200 or 500; omit for the standard disk

arguments.name: workspace_version_id
arguments.desc: Immutable Workspace version to restore before the command; requires enabled persistent storage

arguments.name: model_references
arguments.desc: Pinned public model references from resolve_model_reference. Downloads into $CLOUDGPU_MODEL_DIR/<name> before the command; download time consumes the same GPU budget. No R2 cache or remote repository code execution.

arguments.name: outputs
arguments.desc: Explicit relative output files under $CLOUDGPU_OUTPUT_DIR; no globs, symlinks, hidden or credential files. Default total limit 10 MiB, maximum 100 MiB. Only set accept_storage_charges=true after the user agrees to existing paid storage terms. Inspect output_collection after completion; the GPU is released even if saving fails.

arguments.name: quote_id
arguments.desc: Server quote from quote_compute, starting quote_; binds configuration and checks price at submission

arguments.name: max_spend_usd
arguments.desc: Budget for this job in USD (at most 50)

arguments.name: max_hours
arguments.desc: Hard time limit in hours (at most 24)

arguments.name: user_confirmed
arguments.desc: true only if the user explicitly approved the GPU, budget and time limit

arguments.name: idempotency_key
arguments.desc: Reuse the same value when retrying the same job

name: cancel_job
description: Stops a job: if a GPU was started it is destroyed and billing stops. Output not yet uploaded by the command is lost.

name: run_command
description: Runs a bash command on the instance as root, in an interactive-style shell so conda/venv from ~/.bashrc are active. Foreground returns the exit code and the last 20k characters of output. For anything longer than a few minutes (training, big downloads) use background=true, then tail_logs.

name: upload
description: Copies a local file or directory (this computer) to the instance over SFTP. node_modules, .git and __pycache__ are skipped. Credentials files (.ssh, .env, keys) are refused unless allow_sensitive is true and the user asked for it.

arguments.name: remote_path
arguments.desc: Destination on the instance, e.g. /root/project or /root/data/

name: download
description: Copies a file or directory from the instance to this computer. Do this for every result before stop_instance: destroying an instance erases its disk.

arguments.name: local_path
arguments.desc: Local destination file or directory, e.g. ./outputs/

name: tail_logs
description: Last lines of a background job's log (job_id) or any log file (path), whether the job is still running and its exit code, plus current GPU utilisation and memory.

name: stop_instance
description: Destroys the instance and stops billing. Its disk is erased. If commands were run on it in this session and nothing was downloaded, this refuses unless force=true (only after the user confirms the results are not needed).
